ayahs.arabic: وَٱلذَّٰرِيَٰتِ ذَرۡوࣰ ا
ayahs.translit: Waalththariyati tharwan

t.eng-ummmuhammad: By those [winds] scattering [dust] dispersing

ayahs.arabic: فَٱلۡحَٰمِلَٰتِ وِقۡرࣰ ا
ayahs.translit: Faalhamilati wiqran

t.eng-ummmuhammad: And those [clouds] carrying a load [of water]

ayahs.arabic: فَٱلۡجَٰرِيَٰتِ يُسۡرࣰ ا
ayahs.translit: Faaljariyati yusran

t.eng-ummmuhammad: And those [ships] sailing with ease

ayahs.arabic: فَٱلۡمُقَسِّمَٰتِ أَمۡرًا
ayahs.translit: Faalmuqassimati amran

t.eng-ummmuhammad: And those [angels] apportioning [each] matter

ayahs.arabic: إِنَّمَا تُوعَدُونَ لَصَادِقࣱ‏
ayahs.translit: Innama tooAAadoona lasadiqun

t.eng-ummmuhammad: Indeed, what you are promised is true

ayahs.arabic: وَإِنَّ ٱلدِّينَ لَوَٰقِعࣱ‏
ayahs.translit: Wainna alddeena lawaqiAAun

t.eng-ummmuhammad: And indeed, the recompense is to occur

ayahs.arabic: وَٱلسَّمَآءِ ذَاتِ ٱلۡحُبُكِ
ayahs.translit: Waalssamai thati alhubuki

t.eng-ummmuhammad: By the heaven containing pathways

ayahs.arabic: إِنَّكُمۡ لَفِي قَوۡلࣲ مُّخۡتَلِفࣲ‏
ayahs.translit: Innakum lafee qawlin mukhtalifin

t.eng-ummmuhammad: Indeed, you are in differing speech

ayahs.arabic: يُؤۡفَكُ عَنۡهُ مَنۡ أُفِكَ
ayahs.translit: Yufaku AAanhu man ofika

t.eng-ummmuhammad: Deluded away from the Qur'an is he who is deluded

ayahs.arabic: قُتِلَ ٱلۡخَرَّٰصُونَ
ayahs.translit: Qutila alkharrasoona

t.eng-ummmuhammad: Destroyed are the falsifiers

ayahs.arabic: ٱلَّذِينَ هُمۡ فِي غَمۡرَةࣲ سَاهُونَ
ayahs.translit: Allatheena hum fee ghamratin sahoona

t.eng-ummmuhammad: Who are within a flood [of confusion] and heedless

ayahs.arabic: يَسۡـَٔلُونَ أَيَّانَ يَوۡمُ ٱلدِّينِ
ayahs.translit: Yasaloona ayyana yawmu alddeeni

t.eng-ummmuhammad: They ask, "When is the Day of Recompense

ayahs.arabic: يَوۡمَ هُمۡ عَلَى ٱلنَّارِ يُفۡتَنُونَ
ayahs.translit: Yawma hum AAala alnnari yuftanoona

t.eng-ummmuhammad: [It is] the Day they will be tormented over the Fire

ayahs.arabic: ذُوقُواْ فِتۡنَتَكُمۡ هَٰذَا ٱلَّذِي كُنتُم بِهِۦ تَسۡتَعۡجِلُونَ
ayahs.translit: Thooqoo fitnatakum hatha allathee kuntum bihi tastaAAjiloona

t.eng-ummmuhammad: [And will be told], "Taste your torment. This is that for which you were impatient

ayahs.arabic: إِنَّ ٱلۡمُتَّقِينَ فِي جَنَّٰتࣲ وَعُيُونٍ
ayahs.translit: Inna almuttaqeena fee jannatin waAAuyoonin

t.eng-ummmuhammad: Indeed, the righteous will be among gardens and springs

ayahs.arabic: ءَاخِذِينَ مَآ ءَاتَىٰهُمۡ رَبُّهُمۡۚ إِنَّهُمۡ كَانُواْ قَبۡلَ ذَٰلِكَ مُحۡسِنِينَ
ayahs.translit: Akhitheena ma atahum rabbuhum innahum kanoo qabla thalika muhsineena

t.eng-ummmuhammad: Accepting what their Lord has given them. Indeed, they were before that doers of good

ayahs.arabic: كَانُواْ قَلِيلࣰ ا مِّنَ ٱلَّيۡلِ مَا يَهۡجَعُونَ
ayahs.translit: Kanoo qaleelan mina allayli ma yahjaAAoona

t.eng-ummmuhammad: They used to sleep but little of the night

ayahs.arabic: وَبِٱلۡأَسۡحَارِ هُمۡ يَسۡتَغۡفِرُونَ
ayahs.translit: Wabialashari hum yastaghfiroona

t.eng-ummmuhammad: And in the hours before dawn they would ask forgiveness

ayahs.arabic: وَفِيٓ أَمۡوَٰلِهِمۡ حَقࣱّ لِّلسَّآئِلِ وَٱلۡمَحۡرُومِ
ayahs.translit: Wafee amwalihim haqqun lilssaili waalmahroomi

t.eng-ummmuhammad: And from their properties was [given] the right of the [needy] petitioner and the deprived

ayahs.arabic: وَفِي ٱلۡأَرۡضِ ءَايَٰتࣱ لِّلۡمُوقِنِينَ
ayahs.translit: Wafee alardi ayatun lilmooqineena

t.eng-ummmuhammad: And on the earth are signs for the certain [in faith]

ayahs.arabic: وَفِيٓ أَنفُسِكُمۡۚ أَفَلَا تُبۡصِرُونَ
ayahs.translit: Wafee anfusikum afala tubsiroona

t.eng-ummmuhammad: And in yourselves. Then will you not see

ayahs.arabic: وَفِي ٱلسَّمَآءِ رِزۡقُكُمۡ وَمَا تُوعَدُونَ
ayahs.translit: Wafee alssamai rizqukum wama tooAAadoona

t.eng-ummmuhammad: And in the heaven is your provision and whatever you are promised

ayahs.arabic: فَوَرَبِّ ٱلسَّمَآءِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضِ إِنَّهُۥ لَحَقࣱّ مِّثۡلَ مَآ أَنَّكُمۡ تَنطِقُونَ
ayahs.translit: Fawarabbi alssamai waalardi innahu lahaqqun mithla ma annakum tantiqoona

t.eng-ummmuhammad: Then by the Lord of the heaven and earth, indeed, it is truth - just as [sure as] it is that you are speaking

ayahs.arabic: هَلۡ أَتَىٰكَ حَدِيثُ ضَيۡفِ إِبۡرَٰهِيمَ ٱلۡمُكۡرَمِينَ
ayahs.translit: Hal ataka hadeethu dayfi ibraheema almukrameena

t.eng-ummmuhammad: Has there reached you the story of the honored guests of Abraham

ayahs.arabic: إِذۡ دَخَلُواْ عَلَيۡهِ فَقَالُواْ سَلَٰمࣰ اۖ قَالَ سَلَٰمࣱ قَوۡمࣱ مُّنكَرُونَ
ayahs.translit: Ith dakhaloo AAalayhi faqaloo salaman qala salamun qawmun munkaroona

t.eng-ummmuhammad: When they entered upon him and said, "[We greet you with] peace." He answered, "[And upon you] peace, [you are] a people unknown

ayahs.arabic: فَرَاغَ إِلَىٰٓ أَهۡلِهِۦ فَجَآءَ بِعِجۡلࣲ سَمِينࣲ‏
ayahs.translit: Faragha ila ahlihi fajaa biAAijlin sameenin

t.eng-ummmuhammad: Then he went to his family and came with a fat [roasted] calf

ayahs.arabic: فَقَرَّبَهُۥٓ إِلَيۡهِمۡ قَالَ أَلَا تَأۡكُلُونَ
ayahs.translit: Faqarrabahu ilayhim qala ala takuloona

t.eng-ummmuhammad: And placed it near them; he said, "Will you not eat

ayahs.arabic: فَأَوۡجَسَ مِنۡهُمۡ خِيفَةࣰۖ قَالُواْ لَا تَخَفۡۖ وَبَشَّرُوهُ بِغُلَٰمٍ عَلِيمࣲ‏
ayahs.translit: Faawjasa minhum kheefatan qaloo la takhaf wabashsharoohu bighulamin AAaleemin

t.eng-ummmuhammad: And he felt from them apprehension. They said, "Fear not," and gave him good tidings of a learned boy

ayahs.arabic: فَأَقۡبَلَتِ ٱمۡرَأَتُهُۥ فِي صَرَّةࣲ فَصَكَّتۡ وَجۡهَهَا وَقَالَتۡ عَجُوزٌ عَقِيمࣱ‏
ayahs.translit: Faaqbalati imraatuhu fee sarratin fasakkat wajhaha waqalat AAajoozun AAaqeemun

t.eng-ummmuhammad: And his wife approached with a cry [of alarm] and struck her face and said, "[I am] a barren old woman

ayahs.arabic: قَالُواْ كَذَٰلِكِ قَالَ رَبُّكِۖ إِنَّهُۥ هُوَ ٱلۡحَكِيمُ ٱلۡعَلِيمُ
ayahs.translit: Qaloo kathaliki qala rabbuki innahu huwa alhakeemu alAAaleemu

t.eng-ummmuhammad: They said, "Thus has said your Lord; indeed, He is the Wise, the Knowing

ayahs.arabic: ۞قَالَ فَمَا خَطۡبُكُمۡ أَيُّهَا ٱلۡمُرۡسَلُونَ
ayahs.translit: Qala fama khatbukum ayyuha almursaloona

t.eng-ummmuhammad: [Abraham] said, "Then what is your business [here], O messengers

ayahs.arabic: قَالُوٓاْ إِنَّآ أُرۡسِلۡنَآ إِلَىٰ قَوۡمࣲ مُّجۡرِمِينَ
ayahs.translit: Qaloo inna orsilna ila qawmin mujrimeena

t.eng-ummmuhammad: They said, "Indeed, we have been sent to a people of criminals

ayahs.arabic: لِنُرۡسِلَ عَلَيۡهِمۡ حِجَارَةࣰ مِّن طِينࣲ‏
ayahs.translit: Linursila AAalayhim hijaratan min teenin

t.eng-ummmuhammad: To send down upon them stones of clay

ayahs.arabic: مُّسَوَّمَةً عِندَ رَبِّكَ لِلۡمُسۡرِفِينَ
ayahs.translit: Musawwamatan AAinda rabbika lilmusrifeena

t.eng-ummmuhammad: Marked in the presence of your Lord for the transgressors

ayahs.arabic: فَأَخۡرَجۡنَا مَن كَانَ فِيهَا مِنَ ٱلۡمُؤۡمِنِينَ
ayahs.translit: Faakhrajna man kana feeha mina almumineena

t.eng-ummmuhammad: So We brought out whoever was in the cities of the believers

ayahs.arabic: فَمَا وَجَدۡنَا فِيهَا غَيۡرَ بَيۡتࣲ مِّنَ ٱلۡمُسۡلِمِينَ
ayahs.translit: Fama wajadna feeha ghayra baytin mina almuslimeena

t.eng-ummmuhammad: And We found not within them other than a [single] house of Muslims

ayahs.arabic: وَتَرَكۡنَا فِيهَآ ءَايَةࣰ لِّلَّذِينَ يَخَافُونَ ٱلۡعَذَابَ ٱلۡأَلِيمَ
ayahs.translit: Watarakna feeha ayatan lillatheena yakhafoona alAAathaba alaleema

t.eng-ummmuhammad: And We left therein a sign for those who fear the painful punishment

ayahs.arabic: وَفِي مُوسَىٰٓ إِذۡ أَرۡسَلۡنَٰهُ إِلَىٰ فِرۡعَوۡنَ بِسُلۡطَٰنࣲ مُّبِينࣲ‏
ayahs.translit: Wafee moosa ith arsalnahu ila firAAawna bisultanin mubeenin

t.eng-ummmuhammad: And in Moses [was a sign], when We sent him to Pharaoh with clear authority

ayahs.arabic: فَتَوَلَّىٰ بِرُكۡنِهِۦ وَقَالَ سَٰحِرٌ أَوۡ مَجۡنُونࣱ‏
ayahs.translit: Fatawalla biruknihi waqala sahirun aw majnoonun

t.eng-ummmuhammad: But he turned away with his supporters and said," A magician or a madman

ayahs.arabic: فَأَخَذۡنَٰهُ وَجُنُودَهُۥ فَنَبَذۡنَٰهُمۡ فِي ٱلۡيَمِّ وَهُوَ مُلِيمࣱ‏
ayahs.translit: Faakhathnahu wajunoodahu fanabathnahum fee alyammi wahuwa muleemun

t.eng-ummmuhammad: So We took him and his soldiers and cast them into the sea, and he was blameworthy

ayahs.arabic: وَفِي عَادٍ إِذۡ أَرۡسَلۡنَا عَلَيۡهِمُ ٱلرِّيحَ ٱلۡعَقِيمَ
ayahs.translit: Wafee AAadin ith arsalna AAalayhimu alrreeha alAAaqeema

t.eng-ummmuhammad: And in 'Aad [was a sign], when We sent against them the barren wind

ayahs.arabic: مَا تَذَرُ مِن شَيۡءٍ أَتَتۡ عَلَيۡهِ إِلَّا جَعَلَتۡهُ كَٱلرَّمِيمِ
ayahs.translit: Ma tatharu min shayin atat AAalayhi illa jaAAalathu kaalrrameemi

t.eng-ummmuhammad: It left nothing of what it came upon but that it made it like disintegrated ruins

ayahs.arabic: وَفِي ثَمُودَ إِذۡ قِيلَ لَهُمۡ تَمَتَّعُواْ حَتَّىٰ حِينࣲ‏
ayahs.translit: Wafee thamooda ith qeela lahum tamattaAAoo hatta heenin

t.eng-ummmuhammad: And in Thamud, when it was said to them, "Enjoy yourselves for a time

ayahs.arabic: فَعَتَوۡاْ عَنۡ أَمۡرِ رَبِّهِمۡ فَأَخَذَتۡهُمُ ٱلصَّٰعِقَةُ وَهُمۡ يَنظُرُونَ
ayahs.translit: FaAAataw AAan amri rabbihim faakhathathumu alssaAAiqatu wahum yanthuroona

t.eng-ummmuhammad: But they were insolent toward the command of their Lord, so the thunderbolt seized them while they were looking on

ayahs.arabic: فَمَا ٱسۡتَطَٰعُواْ مِن قِيَامࣲ وَمَا كَانُواْ مُنتَصِرِينَ
ayahs.translit: Fama istataAAoo min qiyamin wama kanoo muntasireena

t.eng-ummmuhammad: And they were unable to arise, nor could they defend themselves

ayahs.arabic: وَقَوۡمَ نُوحࣲ مِّن قَبۡلُۖ إِنَّهُمۡ كَانُواْ قَوۡمࣰ ا فَٰسِقِينَ
ayahs.translit: Waqawma noohin min qablu innahum kanoo qawman fasiqeena

t.eng-ummmuhammad: And [We destroyed] the people of Noah before; indeed, they were a people defiantly disobedient

ayahs.arabic: وَٱلسَّمَآءَ بَنَيۡنَٰهَا بِأَيۡيْدࣲ وَإِنَّا لَمُوسِعُونَ
ayahs.translit: Waalssamaa banaynaha biaydin wainna lamoosiAAoona

t.eng-ummmuhammad: And the heaven We constructed with strength, and indeed, We are [its] expander

ayahs.arabic: وَٱلۡأَرۡضَ فَرَشۡنَٰهَا فَنِعۡمَ ٱلۡمَٰهِدُونَ
ayahs.translit: Waalarda farashnaha faniAAma almahidoona

t.eng-ummmuhammad: And the earth We have spread out, and excellent is the preparer

ayahs.arabic: وَمِن كُلِّ شَيۡءٍ خَلَقۡنَا زَوۡجَيۡنِ لَعَلَّكُمۡ تَذَكَّرُونَ
ayahs.translit: Wamin kulli shayin khalaqna zawjayni laAAallakum tathakkaroona

t.eng-ummmuhammad: And of all things We created two mates; perhaps you will remember

ayahs.arabic: فَفِرُّوٓاْ إِلَى ٱللَّهِۖ إِنِّي لَكُم مِّنۡهُ نَذِيرࣱ مُّبِينࣱ‏
ayahs.translit: Fafirroo ila Allahi innee lakum minhu natheerun mubeenun

t.eng-ummmuhammad: So flee to Allah. Indeed, I am to you from Him a clear warner

ayahs.arabic: وَلَا تَجۡعَلُواْ مَعَ ٱللَّهِ إِلَٰهًا ءَاخَرَۖ إِنِّي لَكُم مِّنۡهُ نَذِيرࣱ مُّبِينࣱ‏
ayahs.translit: Wala tajAAaloo maAAa Allahi ilahan akhara innee lakum minhu natheerun mubeenun

t.eng-ummmuhammad: And do not make [as equal] with Allah another deity. Indeed, I am to you from Him a clear warner

ayahs.arabic: كَذَٰلِكَ مَآ أَتَى ٱلَّذِينَ مِن قَبۡلِهِم مِّن رَّسُولٍ إِلَّا قَالُواْ سَاحِرٌ أَوۡ مَجۡنُونٌ
ayahs.translit: Kathalika ma ata allatheena min qablihim min rasoolin illa qaloo sahirun aw majnoonun

t.eng-ummmuhammad: Similarly, there came not to those before them any messenger except that they said, "A magician or a madman

ayahs.arabic: أَتَوَاصَوۡاْ بِهِۦۚ بَلۡ هُمۡ قَوۡمࣱ طَاغُونَ
ayahs.translit: Atawasaw bihi bal hum qawmun taghoona

t.eng-ummmuhammad: Did they suggest it to them? Rather, they [themselves] are a transgressing people

ayahs.arabic: فَتَوَلَّ عَنۡهُمۡ فَمَآ أَنتَ بِمَلُومࣲ‏
ayahs.translit: Fatawalla AAanhum fama anta bimaloomin

t.eng-ummmuhammad: So leave them, [O Muhammad], for you are not to be blamed

ayahs.arabic: وَذَكِّرۡ فَإِنَّ ٱلذِّكۡرَىٰ تَنفَعُ ٱلۡمُؤۡمِنِينَ
ayahs.translit: Wathakkir fainna alththikra tanfaAAu almumineena

t.eng-ummmuhammad: And remind, for indeed, the reminder benefits the believers

ayahs.arabic: وَمَا خَلَقۡتُ ٱلۡجِنَّ وَٱلۡإِنسَ إِلَّا لِيَعۡبُدُونِ
ayahs.translit: Wama khalaqtu aljinna waalinsa illa liyaAAbudooni

t.eng-ummmuhammad: And I did not create the jinn and mankind except to worship Me

ayahs.arabic: مَآ أُرِيدُ مِنۡهُم مِّن رِّزۡقࣲ وَمَآ أُرِيدُ أَن يُطۡعِمُونِ
ayahs.translit: Ma oreedu minhum min rizqin wama oreedu an yutAAimooni

t.eng-ummmuhammad: I do not want from them any provision, nor do I want them to feed Me

ayahs.arabic: إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ هُوَ ٱلرَّزَّاقُ ذُو ٱلۡقُوَّةِ ٱلۡمَتِينُ
ayahs.translit: Inna Allaha huwa alrrazzaqu thoo alquwwati almateenu

t.eng-ummmuhammad: Indeed, it is Allah who is the [continual] Provider, the firm possessor of strength

ayahs.arabic: فَإِنَّ لِلَّذِينَ ظَلَمُواْ ذَنُوبࣰ ا مِّثۡلَ ذَنُوبِ أَصۡحَٰبِهِمۡ فَلَا يَسۡتَعۡجِلُونِ
ayahs.translit: Fainna lillatheena thalamoo thanooban mithla thanoobi ashabihim fala yastaAAjiloona

t.eng-ummmuhammad: And indeed, for those who have wronged is a portion [of punishment] like the portion of their predecessors, so let them not impatiently urge Me

ayahs.arabic: فَوَيۡلࣱ لِّلَّذِينَ كَفَرُواْ مِن يَوۡمِهِمُ ٱلَّذِي يُوعَدُونَ
ayahs.translit: Fawaylun lillatheena kafaroo min yawmihimu allathee yooAAadoona

t.eng-ummmuhammad: And woe to those who have disbelieved from their Day which they are promised
